'''Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck''' is a constructed format on [[GEMP]] whose card pool runs from [[Premiere]] through the [[Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]] product.<ref name="t82166" /> GEMP lists it as '''Premiere - JPSD''' (code <code>premiere_jpsd</code>), with Decipher set ids 1&ndash;9 and premium ids 101&ndash;112.<ref name="gemp" /> Forum threads also call it "P-JPSD".<ref name="t80297" />

== Deck size ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Default deck size on [[GEMP]]
| 60 cards
|}
The GEMP format definition sets no deck size, so GEMP uses its default of 60 cards.<ref name="gemp-ec48dc19" /><ref name="lib-ec48dc19" />

== Retro League ==
The format was Event 4 of the [[Retro League]] in 2022 and 2023.
{| class="wikitable"
! Event !! Dates !! Winner
|-
| [[2023 Retro League|2023 Retro League Event 4]] || 30 July – 10 September 2023 || [[Timo Dusel]]<ref name="t82166" />
|-
| [[2022 Retro League Event 4]] || late July – early September 2022 || [[Jared Napolitano]]<ref name="t80297" />
|}
